doctrine: Illustrative instance showing all three publication states. A row may only be advertised on a public surface when state=published.

states.published: A real public repository exists and carries the mirrored content.
states.site-only: Content is published at a URL but no repository exists; verify by URL, never by clone.
states.not-published: Neither exists; the row must not be presented as verifiable.
